meta.description: Registry for candidate symbolic/functional forms for Mono-Process operators.

symbolic_forms.expression: delta(E, R, -(i)) = { c in C | S(c, E, R, -(i)) is maximal }
symbolic_forms.description: Selection-constrained multi-valued continuation where S is a composite selection metric.
Admissibility projection mapping states into window A. Defined by Pi_A(x) = x for x in A.
Transport from locus alpha to beta. Non-invertibility arises from path-dependent residue drift.
Residue update function. Can be modeled as R + dR (amplifying) or R * k (dissipative/saturating).
Selection of candidates minimizing orientation distance. Degeneracy occurs when arg min returns a set.
